newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco invests $55 mln in development projects.
newsitem.headline: Morocco invests $55 mln in development projects.

text.p: Morococan Interior Minister Driss Basri inaugurated development projects costing a total of 520 million dirhams ($55.3 million) in three towns, the official MAP news agency said on Monday.
The projects, including water distribution networks, new roads and micro-enterprises, were in el Gara, Berrachid and Settat neighbouring towns, some 150 km (80 miles) southwest of Rabat, said MAP.
Most of the investment came from private investors with the state and local authorities providing respectively 4.0 and 9.0 percent of the capital, MAP added.
The ceremony took place at the weekend. ($1=9.4 dirhams)
